verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own site presents CHKit as offering typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code, built for agents to drive in CI with reviewable diffs. That makes it a first-party, agent-oriented command tool, but it is never explicitly called a CLI and its scope covers only schema and pipelines. Compatibility with stock ClickHouse clients is an ecosystem capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that CHKit is an official CLI with install/reference docs, CLI coverage of cluster/service management (create, resize, branch), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
